clothing-store.title: Create a professional online clothing store
clothing-store.lead: Show your collection in every size and colour, take orders with cash on delivery, and connect your products to a Meta catalog, with no developer.
checks: A catalog for Instagram and Facebook

needs.title: Sizes and colours for each product
needs.pain: Customers ask which size and colour you have before they order.
needs.solution: Add sizes and colours to the same product, and set a price and quantity for each choice.

needs.title: A photo gallery for each product
needs.pain: People buy clothes with their eyes, and one photo isn't enough.
needs.solution: Upload several photos for each product and each choice, so customers can see the fabric and details from every angle.

needs.title: Offers with a countdown
needs.pain: Sale seasons and holidays are short, and customers put off deciding.
needs.solution: Create discount codes and offers with a clear end date, shown in your store with a countdown.

needs.title: A Meta catalog for Instagram and Facebook
needs.pain: Many clothing customers find products on Instagram.
needs.solution: Copy your product feed link and add it in Meta's Commerce Manager, so you can use your products in ads, and in product tags if Meta offers them on your account.

steps.body: Upload photos, and set the sizes, colours and quantity for each choice.

steps.title: Turn on payment and shipping
steps.body: Cash on delivery is on, and you can connect Paymob or Kashier and Bosta whenever you like.

steps.title: Connect your ads
steps.body: Add your product feed to a Meta catalog, and connect Meta Pixel to measure your ads.

faq.q: How do I add sizes and colours to one product?
faq.a: On the product page, add sizes and colours as options, and set a price and quantity for each choice.

faq.q: Can customers pay on delivery?
faq.a: Yes. Cash on delivery is on from the start. You can also connect Paymob or Kashier for cards and wallets, and take InstaPay straight to your account.

faq.q: How do I handle exchanges and returns?
faq.a: Write your returns and exchange policy in your store settings so customers can see it, and change an order's status to returned from the Orders page.

faq.q: Can I show my products on Instagram and Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. Copy your product feed link from the Apps and integrations page and add it in Meta's Commerce Manager, then connect Meta Pixel to measure sales.

faq.q: Can I run seasonal discounts?
faq.a: Yes. Create discount codes and offers with an end date, and the offer shows in your store with a countdown.

faq.q: I only sell on a Facebook page. Can I bring my products over?
faq.a: Yes. Import your products from an Excel file or a product link, and message us on WhatsApp if you need a hand.

beauty-store.title: A beauty store that suits your products
beauty-store.lead: Create an online beauty store that shows each product clearly, sells two bottles for a better price and tells customers when an item is back, with no developer.

store.announcement: Delivery across Egypt, cash on delivery

needs.title: Several photos per product
needs.pain: Customers want to see the bottle and the texture before they buy.
needs.solution: Upload several photos for each product, and one for each size or type, so the bottle, texture and ingredients are clear.

needs.title: Quantity offers
needs.pain: Skincare runs out, yet most customers buy one bottle at a time.
needs.solution: Add quantity offers to a product, such as a discount for two or three, and the discount is applied at checkout.
needs.label: Choose an offer

needs.title: Back-in-stock alerts
needs.pain: Your best seller sells out, and the customer buys elsewhere.
needs.solution: When a product sells out, customers leave their email and get a message when it's back in stock.
needs.label: Sold out

needs.title: Real reviews on every product
needs.pain: With skincare, customers trust other people's experience more than the description.
needs.solution: Customer reviews show on the product page, and you can add reviews customers sent you on WhatsApp or Instagram.

reviews.text: Light texture and it sinks in fast.
Arrived in two days, well packed.

faq.q: How do I open an online beauty store in Egypt?
faq.a: Sign up to Tallaby, pick one of the beauty templates, then add your products and set delivery prices for each governorate. Cash on delivery is on from the start.

faq.q: Can I sell the same product in more than one size?
faq.a: Yes. Add the sizes as options on the product, and set a price and quantity for each one.

faq.q: How do I run a "buy 2 and save" offer?
faq.a: On the product page, add quantity offers and set the discount for each number of items. Customers see the offer on the product page, and the discount is applied at checkout.

faq.q: What happens when a product sells out?
faq.a: It shows as sold out, and customers can leave their email to get a message when it's back in stock.

faq.q: Can I show my customers' reviews?
faq.a: Yes. Reviews show on the product page, and you can add real reviews customers sent you yourself, from the product page.

faq.q: What's a good name for a beauty store?
faq.a: Pick a short name that's easy to write and say in Arabic and English. You can change the store name later and connect your own domain whenever you like.

perfume-store.title: A perfume store with a premium feel
perfume-store.lead: Create an online perfume store where each scent comes in several sizes and prices, with offers for buying more than one bottle, on a premium template that suits your products.
checks: A size and price per scent

store.announcement: Delivery in 48 hours in Cairo and Giza

needs.title: A size and a price for each scent
needs.pain: The same scent sells in several sizes, and customers ask the price of each.
needs.solution: Add the sizes as options on the perfume, with a price and quantity for each, so customers pick and order straight away.
needs.label: Choose a size

needs.title: Quantity offers
needs.pain: Perfume is bought for yourself and as a gift, but customers hesitate over a second bottle.
needs.solution: Add quantity offers, such as a discount on the second bottle, and the discount is applied at checkout.
needs.label: Choose an offer

needs.title: Photos that do the bottle justice
needs.pain: Nobody can smell a perfume online, so the photos and description do the selling.
needs.solution: Upload several photos of each bottle and its box, and write the notes and ingredients in Arabic and English.

needs.title: Reviews on how long it lasts
needs.pain: The first question about any perfume: does it last?
needs.solution: Customer reviews show on the perfume's page, and you can add feedback customers sent you on WhatsApp.

reviews.text: Lasts all day, and the box is lovely.

faq.q: How do I create an online perfume store?
faq.a: Sign up to Tallaby, pick one of the perfume templates, then add your scents with their sizes and prices. You can start with no monthly fee.

faq.q: Can I sell a perfume in more than one size?
faq.a: Yes. Add the sizes as options, such as 30, 50 and 100 ml, and set a price and quantity for each.

faq.q: Can I sell samples and gift sets?
faq.a: Yes. Add a sample or a set as its own product with its price, or as one of a perfume's sizes, and give it its own category.

faq.q: How do I get customers to buy more than one bottle?
faq.a: Add quantity offers on the perfume's page, such as a discount on the second bottle. The discount is applied at checkout.

faq.q: Can perfume buyers pay on delivery or by card?
faq.a: Yes. Cash on delivery is on from the start, and you can connect Paymob or Kashier to take cards and wallets into your own account.

faq.q: How do I choose a name for a perfume store?
faq.a: Pick a short name that fits the feel of your scents and is easy to write in Arabic and English. You can change it later and connect your own domain.

electronics-store.lead: Create an online electronics store that shows each product's specs clearly, with a storage, colour and price for every option, and lets customers pay by card into your account or on delivery.

needs.pain: Electronics buyers compare specs before they buy, and ask about every detail.
needs.solution: Write the specs in the description in Arabic and English, or upload a product photo or PDF and let AI write them for you.

needs.title: Storage, colour and price per option
needs.pain: The same phone comes in several storage sizes and colours, each with its own price.
needs.solution: Add storage and colour as options, and set a price and quantity for each.

needs.title: Back-in-stock alerts
needs.pain: New devices sell out fast, and customers don't come back to check.
needs.solution: When a product sells out, customers leave their email and get a message when it's back in stock.
needs.label: Sold out

needs.title: Card or cash on delivery
needs.pain: Devices are expensive: some customers prefer a card, others prefer to pay on delivery.
needs.solution: Connect your own Paymob or Kashier account so card payments reach you directly, and set cash on delivery and a delivery price for each area.
needs.note: Cash on delivery in every area

faq.q: How do I open an online electronics store in Egypt?
faq.a: Sign up to Tallaby, pick one of the electronics templates, then add your devices with their specs and set your delivery prices. Cash on delivery is on from the start.

faq.q: Can I sell phone and computer accessories?
faq.a: Yes. Add headphones, chargers, cables and cases as products, and group them in their own categories.

faq.q: Do card payments go into my own account?
faq.a: Yes. You connect your own Paymob or Kashier account, so payments reach you from them directly, and the gateway sets its own fees.

faq.q: How do I add storage and colour to one device?
faq.a: On the product page, add storage and colour as options, and set a price and quantity for each.

faq.q: Can AI write the specs?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a product photo, a PDF or some text, and AI writes the name and description in Arabic and English for you to check before saving.

faq.q: How do I ship orders?
faq.a: Connect your Bosta account to create waybills from the dashboard, or assign orders to your own riders. Tallaby doesn't deliver orders itself.

needs.solution: Set the areas you deliver to and a price for each, down to the district, plus an amount for free delivery.

industriesHub.explainerTitle: How to choose an online store for your kind of business
industriesHub.explainer: Every kind of business needs something different from its online store. A clothing store needs sizes and colours for each product, a perfume store needs a price for each size, a food store needs a delivery price for each area and an instant alert for every order, and a furniture store needs large photos and clear sizes. Each page here shows what your field needs, the Tallaby features live today that cover it, and real templates made for that field that you can preview before signing up. Every store works in Arabic and English, with cash on delivery from the start.
industriesHub.closingTitle: Start your store in your field today
industriesHub.closingBody: Pick a template made for your field, add your products and start taking orders.
